_comment: Copy this to projects.json — that file is per-machine and is NOT tracked.
It names the reports this editor's start page lists, and where each one's
name       what the start page shows
base       the report's staged editor dir, relative to docs/primer/
repo       owner/name the editor's Push sends to. Omit and the editor
asks the first time you Save.
local_root ONLY when the report's files live in a different repo on this
machine. Omit for a report that lives in this one.
With no projects.json at all, every report in this repo's docsync.yml is
still served — you just don't get the start-page grid.
